items.exampleEn: The fishing community here has lived by the sea for centuries.
items.exampleZh: 這裡的漁民群體世世代代都住在海邊。

items.exampleEn: Strong winds often blow across the western coast in winter.
items.exampleZh: 冬天時，西部海岸常吹強風。

items.exampleEn: Domestic flights leave from the smaller terminal next to the main one.
items.exampleZh: 國內航班從主航廈旁邊較小的航廈出發。

items.exampleEn: Urban gardens on top of buildings are becoming popular in big cities.
items.exampleZh: 屋頂上的都市菜園在大城市越來越受歡迎。

items.exampleEn: The doctor drives two hours a day to visit rural villages.
items.exampleZh: 那位醫生每天開車兩個小時去探訪鄉下的村莊。

items.exampleEn: Canada's territory includes thousands of islands.
items.exampleZh: 加拿大的領土包含數千座島嶼。

items.exampleEn: The headquarters of the soccer club has a small museum.
items.exampleZh: 那支足球俱樂部的總部有一間小博物館。

items.exampleEn: The delivery driver left the package on our porch.
items.exampleZh: 送貨司機把包裹放在我們家門廊上。

items.exampleEn: Canada has ten provinces and three territories.
items.exampleZh: 加拿大有十個省和三個地區。

items.sentenceEn: Every evening, my grandparents drink tea on the front porch.
items.sentenceZh: 每天傍晚，我祖父母都在前門廊喝茶。

items.audioEn: Please send the signed papers to our headquarters by Friday, not to this office.
items.audioZh: 請在星期五前把簽好的文件寄到我們總部，不要寄到這個辦公室。

items.sentenceEn: Most of the country's domestic workers now have weekends off.
items.sentenceZh: 這個國家大部分的家務工作者現在週末都能休假。

items.sentenceEn: Young people often leave rural areas to look for work in the city.
items.sentenceZh: 年輕人常離開鄉村地區，到城市找工作。

items.stemEn: Traffic and noise are common problems in ____ areas.
items.stemZh: 交通和噪音是都市地區常見的問題。

items.stemEn: The farmers in this ____ grow most of the country's rice.
items.stemZh: 這個省的農民種植全國大部分的稻米。

items.passageEn: When my company moved its headquarters from the capital to a small town in the western part of the country, many staff were worried. They were used to urban life, with cafes, malls and the subway. But the local community welcomed us warmly. Neighbors invited us to sit on their porches and share cakes they had baked. Life in this rural area is slower, and some colleagues missed city shopping at first. Still, most of us now enjoy the clean air and quiet roads. Our manager, a well-educated and patient woman, says the move has also helped the company win more domestic customers in this province.
items.passageZh: 我們公司把總部從首都搬到國家西部的一個小鎮時，很多員工都很擔心。大家習慣了都市生活，有咖啡館、購物中心和地鐵。不過，當地居民熱情地歡迎我們。鄰居邀我們坐在他們的門廊上，分享他們烤的蛋糕。這個鄉村地區的生活步調比較慢，一開始有些同事很懷念在城市購物。不過，現在我們大多數人都很享受乾淨的空氣和安靜的道路。我們的經理受過良好教育又很有耐心，她說這次搬遷也幫公司在這個省爭取到更多國內客戶。

questions.questionZh: 員工一開始為什麼擔心？
經理說這次搬遷帶來什麼好處？
options: 員工可以天天在家工作
在這個省爭取到更多國內客戶

items.promptZh: 這隻狗會保護牠的地盤，不讓陌生人靠近。
referenceEn: This dog protects its territory and keeps strangers away.
The dog guards its territory and won't let strangers come near.
rubricZh: territory 指動物的地盤（例如 its territory）
動物可用 it，也可用 he、she；時態合理即可

items.promptZh: 社區居民一起把那座舊公園打掃乾淨了。
referenceEn: The local community cleaned up the old park together.
People in the community worked together to clean up the old park.
rubricZh: community 指地方居民、社區（例如 the local community、people in the community 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 cleaned up、have cleaned up 等）
「打掃乾淨」可寫，例如 clean up、tidy up 等
